notable_absence.finding: No management-plane role gate appears anywhere on this data-plane statement page - consistent with round 2's finding that requiresCapellaRole is reserved for a different (management-plane) surface, not statement-level DDL.

cross_product_finding: The Advanced-credential privilege here is two-dimensional: it depends on both credential type AND function scope (global vs scoped) - 'Global Function Manage' for global functions, 'Query Manage' for scoped functions, both under Advanced. Basic collapses both cases to a single coarse 'Write'. This extends the round 2 credential-type/privilege-pair model cleanly to a third axis (object scope) without breaking its shape.
